items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: there is one every year down in Manassas, Virginia, which is sponsored by Fat Cat Johnson McCree - Johnson McCree.

ctx.x: That has become an extremely successful party, too, and of course, as I said, the six month interval doesn't interfere with the Odessa party. I didn't get to say in the Odessa parties, and the guest lists, and also in the Midland parties for Max Christianson, the guest list included many people from all over the country in all walks of life, so that the clientele was not local in entirety, by any means, and

a lot of those people came after they learned of the parties that were regulars at the Gibson parties. So there is a great movement, jazz wise, as a throwoff on the original Gibson parties. We have the one down in Jersey now, and there is one every year down in Manassas, Virginia, which is sponsored by Fat Cat Johnson McCree - Johnson McCree.
And his parties aren't on such a large scale, but it gives many musicians who aren't quite so famous, along with a few famous ones, a chance to participate, and their list ... (CUT)
